lines.text: Ten o'clock at the noodle bar. The last bowl of the night goes out.
You've carried plates here for three years. Tonight, on the walk home, you make up your mind.
I'm not going to carry plates forever. I'm going to be a software developer.
So, from a tiny bedroom, on an old laptop, you register a company of your own.
On the desk sits an old leather book. A Grimoire. Every page is blank.
Every spell you truly learn will be written in here. Stop using it, and the ink fades.
Hello. I'm Sequel. I speak to your database, calmly and precisely.
Hi! I'm Jay! I make your pages move. Let's go, let's go!
Hex. I run the server. Steady, every time.
Then the doorbell chimes. Your first client is already here.
Grimoire. Learn to code by running the company.
